Cyan makes deeper understanding of the insight and moat a condition of evaluating the opportunity further.
Cyan notes that the relevant insight cannot be discussed on the podcast, creating a stated need for follow-up diligence.
Cyan directly describes the founder as very impressive.
Cyan expresses a strongly positive reaction to listening to the founder present.

annotation_summary: Cyan queried round demand and check-size fit, expressed positive founder and communication assessments, and explicitly tied further evaluation to understanding the product insight and moat.
